selection.description: Applications received by 15 March are assessed on a motivational video, upper-secondary exam results, work experience (at least 30 hours a week for three months), stays abroad of at least three months and relevant courses of at least six months.
Qualified applicants may be called for a personal interview.

requirements.label: An IB Diploma, or DP Course Results with at least 18 points, grade 3 in all six subjects and three of them at HL

officialWording.text: IB-elever uden IB Diploma, men med mindst 18 point (Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results), har adgang til videregående uddannelser i Danmark på lige vilkår med ansøgere med den 2-årige hf-eksamen uden overbygning. Det kræver, at alle 6 IB-fag (3 HL-fag og 3 SL- eller 4 HL-fag og 2 SL-fag) er bestået med mindst karakteren 3. Det betyder, at de har adgang til at søge optagelse på erhvervsakademi- og professionsbacheloruddannelser gennem kvote 1 og 2.

requirements.note: The rule is national, not this institution's. The Danish Agency for Higher Education and Science treats DP Course Results of at least 18 points, with grade 3 or more in all six subjects and three at HL, like a two-year hf without overbygning, which gives access to erhvervsakademi and professionsbachelor programmes through quota 1 and quota 2. This is a professionsbachelor programme, which the Agency names directly. The institution's own page names the IB but says nothing about Course Results, so a Course candidate should confirm with admissions in writing. The award does not waive the subject requirements below.

requirements.label: Mathematics at C level, minimum grade 2
requirements.subject: Mathematics

requirements.label: English at B level (minimum 2.0), or an accepted English test

alternatives.label: English at B level, minimum grade 2
alternatives.subject: English

alternatives.label: An accepted English test instead (for example IELTS Academic 6.5)

officialWording.text: To meet the English proficiency requirement through your Upper Secondary School you must document that your English proficiency can be equated to a Danish B-level with a minimum weighted grade point average score of 2.0 on the Danish grading scale. [...] If your English proficiency from your Upper Secondary School does not meet the required level and scores, you must instead deliver an English language test.

officialRequirementsText.text: Admission requirements - One of the following: Upper secondary school leaving certificate/high school exam; The International or the European Baccalaureate; The Danish Admission course for Engineering programmes; [...] Specific admission requirements: A C-level in Mathematics = 125 instructional hours of 60 minutes each. [...] Each of the subjects above must be passed with a min. average of 2.0 on the Danish grading scale.

notes: The programme also has a February start. Only the August 2027 intake is recorded here.
